promises: Free baseline participation does not require a Patreon subscription, account payment or paid upgrade.
Digital trades can happen without payment processing, therefore no Stripe fee applies to a pure card-for-card trade.
For a paid physical item, the seller's agreed item price, any disclosed real shipping and taxes remain separate from DreamLedger platform fees.
If Stripe is used, only actual, disclosed Stripe processing costs may be passed through, without DreamLedger markup. No fee may be described as a Stripe cost unless independently verified.
No paid placement or ranking currently operates. Any future voluntary sponsorship requires explicit owner approval and must not compromise free organic discovery.
B2B and P2P exchange participation are free.
Disputes, fraudulent listings, and unsupported payment methods do not create an automatic DreamLedger charge.
boundary: Only MTG. Do not change fee or privacy rules in unrelated silos.
